scenes.tts: You need twelve to eighteen index cards, crayons or markers, and a ball of yarn.
scenes.narration: You need twelve to eighteen index cards, crayons or markers, and a ball of yarn.

scenes.tts: Draw one card each for sun, grass, grasshopper, frog, snake, and hawk. Line them up by who eats whom. Each person holds one to three cards. Start at the grass and pass the yarn from each food to its eater.

items.text: Pass yarn from food to eater

scenes.narration: Draw one card each for sun, grass, grasshopper, frog, snake, and hawk. Line them up by who eats whom. Each person holds one to three cards. Start at the grass and pass the yarn from each food to its eater.

scenes.tts: Pull one card out and give the yarn a small tug. Anyone who feels it raises a hand. Take out the grass, and usually nearly every hand goes up.

items.text: Pull a card, tug the yarn
Remove grass: most hands go up

scenes.narration: Pull one card out and give the yarn a small tug. Anyone who feels it raises a hand. Take out the grass, and usually nearly every hand goes up.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child the whole time. Never put yarn around a neck, and do not wrap it tightly around fingers or wrists. Nobody walks while holding yarn.
